messages.author: Hana Kobayashi
messages.text: JP-specific cut of the TikTok studio creatives is ready: illustrated style, local voice-over, no English text. JP has our best retention and payer rate so it's worth the effort.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Love it. I'll add them as a separate ad group in tiktok_value_bidding so we can compare cleanly.
